name: source-contract-development-v1
scope: Author-written development fixtures, not independent human gold or an external generalization benchmark. Checks literal requested facts, attribution markers and bounded absence.

items.question: What view of the merger did the report attribute to Dana?

evidence.title: Report
evidence.text: Analyst Dana argued that the merger would benefit customers. The publication did not independently confirm that forecast.

items.question: 根据报道，律师林对交易是否合法有什么说法？

evidence.title: 庭审报道
evidence.text: 律师林表示交易合法，这是辩方主张。检方则指控交易存在欺诈，报道并未替任何一方作事实认定。

items.question: Who raised the concern about Orion and what was alleged?

evidence.title: Audit bulletin
evidence.text: According to the audit team, Orion may have understated costs. This is an allegation pending review, not a confirmed finding.

items.question: Does the entire report never mention fines?

evidence.title: Report excerpt
evidence.text: The provided excerpt describes the estimated operating costs and a tentative launch schedule.

items.question: 整份通知是否从未说明审批人？

evidence.title: 通知节选
evidence.text: 本段通知说明材料提交日期为6月1日，后续安排将在下一页说明。

items.question: Does the policy require approval?

evidence.title: Approval policy
evidence.text: The policy explicitly states that no approval is required for this operation.

must_match: no approval|not require approval|无需审批|不需要审批|无需批准|不需要批准|不需批准|不需审批

items.question: Are the launch dates consistent in both reports, despite different operating hours?

evidence.title: Report A
evidence.text: The launch date is April 8. Operating hours are 09:00–17:00.

evidence.title: Report B
evidence.text: The launch date is April 8. Operating hours are 10:00–16:00.

items.question: 两份通知的生效日期是否一致？注意不要比较发布日期。

evidence.title: 通知甲
evidence.text: 发布日期为5月20日，生效日期为6月1日。

evidence.title: 通知乙
evidence.text: 发布日期为5月25日，生效日期为6月1日。

items.question: Was fantasy football strategy consistent between the reports when Alex was absent?

evidence.title: Report A
evidence.text: If Alex is absent, start Riley as the replacement. Alex is currently unlikely to play.

evidence.title: Report B
evidence.text: If Alex is absent, start Riley as the replacement. Alex is now more likely to play.
